tool_schemas.name: get-cargo-package-details
tool_schemas.description: Returns our normalized details for the Cargo package identified by `name`, including the latest cached upstream metadata we have for that crate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is missing or empty, NOT_FOUND if the crate is unknown to our registry cache, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed request quotas. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when we cannot refresh or retrieve required upstream metadata at request time.

tool_schemas.name: search-cargo-packages
tool_schemas.description: Searches Cargo crates using `query` and returns a relevance-ordered list of matching packages, limited to `limit` results (no cursor-based paging; increase `limit` to fetch more up to the maximum). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty or `limit` is outside allowed bounds, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed request quotas. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when upstream search cannot be reached and no usable cached result is available.

tool_schemas.name: list-cargo-package-versions
tool_schemas.description: Lists known versions for the Cargo package identified by `name` and returns up to `limit` versions (no cursor-based paging; increase `limit` to fetch more up to the maximum). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is missing/empty or `limit` is outside allowed bounds, NOT_FOUND if the crate is unknown to our registry cache, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed request quotas. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when upstream version data cannot be reached and we cannot serve a cached version list.

tool_schemas.name: get-golang-package-details
tool_schemas.description: Returns our normalized details for the Go module identified by `module`, including the latest cached upstream metadata we have for that module path. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `module` is missing or empty, NOT_FOUND if the module is unknown to our registry cache, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed request quotas. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when we cannot refresh or retrieve required upstream metadata at request time.

tool_schemas.description: Lists known versions for the Go module identified by `module` and returns up to `limit` versions (no cursor-based paging; increase `limit` to fetch more up to the maximum). Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when upstream version data cannot be reached and we cannot serve a cached version list.

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is missing or empty, NOT_FOUND if the package is unknown to our registry cache, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed request quotas. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when we cannot refresh or retrieve required upstream metadata at request time.

tool_schemas.name: search-npm-packages

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty or `limit` is outside allowed bounds, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed request quotas. tool_schemas.name: get-nuget-package-details
tool_schemas.description: Returns our normalized details for the NuGet package identified by `name`, including the latest cached upstream metadata we have for that package. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is missing or empty, NOT_FOUND if the package is unknown to our registry cache, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed request quotas. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when we cannot refresh or retrieve required upstream metadata at request time.

tool_schemas.name: search-nuget-packages
tool_schemas.description: Searches NuGet packages using `query` and returns a relevance-ordered list of matching packages, limited to `limit` results (no cursor-based paging; increase `limit` to fetch more up to the maximum). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty or `limit` is outside allowed bounds, and RATE_LIMITED if you exceed request quotas. Raises UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE when upstream search cannot be reached and no usable cached result is available.

tool_schemas.name: list-nuget-package-versions
tool_schemas.description: Lists known versions for the specified NuGet package name and returns a version list ordered from newest to oldest, limited to the first `limit` results (default 100, max 1000). This endpoint does not support pagination beyond `limit`; request a larger `limit` (up to 1000) to retrieve more results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is empty or `limit` is out of range, NOT_FOUND if the package is not known in the NuGet registry cache, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-pypi-package-details
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed cached metadata for the specified PyPI package name, including its normalized identity and associated upstream fields as available. The response is a single package object (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is empty, NOT_FOUND if the package is not known in the PyPI registry cache, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list-pypi-package-versions
tool_schemas.description: Lists known versions for the specified PyPI package name and returns a version list ordered from newest to oldest, limited to the first `limit` results (default 100, max 1000). This endpoint does not support pagination beyond `limit`; request a larger `limit` (up to 1000) to retrieve more results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is empty or `limit` is out of range, NOT_FOUND if the package is not known in the PyPI registry cache, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.
